title: Design System: Riftcount Deck Board
scope: /deck/ only. The marketing home and /amber/ are separate surfaces outside this system.

body.purpose: Default text and row names; tabular figures.

body-sm.purpose: Fields, menus, rune names, read text.

mono.purpose: Decklist text, deck codes, calculation notes.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Gallery art on hover/focus with a 3px rise.

shadows.name: thumb-lift
shadows.purpose: Deck thumbnails on hover with a 2px rise.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for lifts, sheets, toasts, row and card entry.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: Tile and thumbnail hover lift; tab pane fade-in.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions and animations under prefers-reduced-motion; scripted animations skipped.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default action: grouped-panel fill, steps to raise on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:32px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:var(--r,6px);background:var(--card,#161618);color:var(--text,#fff);font:500 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;transition:background-color .15s,transform .1s;cursor:pointer}.ds-btn:hover{background:var(--raise,#1f1f22)}.ds-btn:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one green action in view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:32px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:var(--r,6px);background:var(--green,#30d158);color:var(--green-ink,#002a0f);font:600 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;transition:background-color .15s,transform .1s;cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:#3ee066}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Segmented Control / Tabs
components.description: Deck panel tabs, view switch and type filter.
components.css: .ds-seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:2px;padding:2px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--card,#161618);width:360px}.ds-seg button{height:30px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:none;color:var(--text-2,#8e8e93);font:600 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s}.ds-seg button:hover{color:#fff}.ds-seg button[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--seg,#2c2c2e);color:#fff}.ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Search Field
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:360px;height:36px;padding:0 10px 0 12px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--card,#161618);color:var(--text-3,#6c6c70);font:400 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif}.ds-search input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:none;color:#fff;font:inherit;outline:none}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--text-3,#6c6c70)}.ds-search span{font-size:12px}.ds-search:focus-within{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18)}

components.name: Count Chips and Legality Pill
components.description: Capsule counts that turn green when complete, red when over; status pill.
components.html: LegalMain 40/40Runes 13/12Sideboard 0/10
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif}.ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:26px;padding:0 9px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--card,#161618);font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2,#8e8e93)}.ds-chip b{font-weight:600;color:#fff}.ds-chip.ok b{color:var(--green,#30d158)}.ds-chip.over b{color:var(--red,#ff453a)}.ds-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;height:28px;padding:0 11px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green-soft,rgba(48,209,88,.16));color:var(--green,#30d158);font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.ds-pill i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}

components.name: Values Toggle
components.description: Capsule toggle; on = green soft fill.
components.html: <button class="ds-toggle" aria-pressed="true">Values</button> <button class="ds-toggle" aria-pressed="false">In deck only</button>
components.css: .ds-toggle{height:30px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:999px;background:none;color:var(--text-2,#8e8e93);font:400 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-toggle:hover{color:#fff}.ds-toggle[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--green-soft,rgba(48,209,88,.16));border-color:transparent;color:var(--green,#30d158)}.ds-toggle:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Value Band
components.description: Signature: deck value readout with the centre-par bar.
components.html:
2.02
value per cost in this deck

Riot's ledger prices this list at 1.69; partners in the deck move it +19%.
components.css: .ds-vband{width:340px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--card,#161618);color:#fff;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-vnum{font-size:30px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1;color:var(--green,#30d158)}.ds-vlbl{margin-top:4px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2,#8e8e93)}.ds-vbar{position:relative;display:block;height:4px;margin-top:10px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.ds-vbar i{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-2px;bottom:-2px;width:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.32)}.ds-vbar b{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;border-radius:2px;background:var(--green,#30d158)}.ds-vband p{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2,#8e8e93)}

components.name: Deck Row
components.description: Rows view: quantity, cost badge, name over value bar, readout.
components.html:
32Scuttle Crab1.86
21Defy0.83
components.css: .ds-list{width:380px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--card,#161618);overflow:hidden;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#fff}.ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px 34px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:44px;padding:6px 12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}.ds-row:first-child{border-top:0}.ds-row:hover{background:var(--raise,#1f1f22)}.ds-row>b{text-align:right;font-size:15px;font-weight:650}.ds-cost{display:grid;place-items:center;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--seg,#2c2c2e);font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.ds-nm{display:grid;gap:5px;font-size:15px}.ds-row .up,.ds-row .down{font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.up{color:var(--green,#30d158)}.down{color:var(--red,#ff453a)}.ds-vbar{position:relative;display:block;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.ds-vbar i{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-2px;bottom:-2px;width:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.32)}.ds-vbar b{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;border-radius:2px;background:var(--green,#30d158)}.ds-vbar b.down{background:var(--red,#ff453a)}.ds-vbar b.soft{opacity:.5}

components.name: Phone Peek Bar
components.description: Resting state of the phone bottom sheet.
components.css: .ds-peek{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:360px;height:64px;padding:12px 16px 8px;border:0;border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;background:var(--sheet-phone,#0c0c0e);color:#fff;text-align:left;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;box-shadow:0 -18px 40px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.95);cursor:pointer}.ds-peek .g{position:absolute;left:50%;top:6px;translate:-50% 0;width:36px;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}.ds-peek .t{flex:1;display:grid}.ds-peek b{font-size:15px;font-weight:600}.ds-peek .t span{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2,#8e8e93)}.ds-peek svg{color:var(--text-2,#8e8e93)}.ds-peek:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Popover Menu
components.css: .ds-menu{display:grid;width:220px;padding:5px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--popover,#1c1c1e);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.1),0 18px 36px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.9);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif}.ds-menu button{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 10px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:none;color:#fff;font-size:14px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-menu button:hover,.ds-menu button:focus-visible{background:var(--seg,#2c2c2e);outline:none}.ds-menu b{font-weight:500;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2,#8e8e93)}.ds-menu hr{margin:4px 6px;border:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Black Instrument Panel"**

The deck builder looks like the Riftcount iOS app it sits beside: a true black ground, grouped panels a few steps above it, white hairlines, system type in normal case and one system green. The card art is the only full colour on screen; everything the board draws around it is quiet, so counts, legality and value read at a glance and no control has to be hunted for.

Density is roomy rather than terminal-tight: 44px deck rows, 30-36px controls, 16-18px gutters, and two panes that each scroll on their own. The gallery owns the left of the screen; the deck sits in a resizable panel on the right with Deck, Stats, Hand and Coach one tab apart. On a phone the gallery takes the full screen and the deck becomes a bottom sheet behind a peek bar.

Value is the one idea the board draws in its own way. Every value is a ratio against par (1.00), and it is shown as a bar growing from a centre par line: green to the right above par, red to the left below, softer inside the normal band. The world refuses the genre's gold-trimmed gallery, glows and neon outlines, and the enlarged hover loupe.
keyCharacteristics: True black ground with tonal grouped panels; no bezels, no glow, hairlines only.
System UI type in normal case, tabular numbers everywhere.
One accent: system green for legal, complete, selected-as-on and above par.
Red only below par and for errors; gold only for the rare Pair highlight.
Subtle 6px corners on controls, 10px on grouped panels, capsules for pills.
Values drawn as centre-par bars on a ratio scale.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green is the only accent. It means legal, complete, on, or above par. Nothing decorative is green.

rules.name: The Red Means Under Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for a value below par or an error or limit breach. A low number that is not a fault stays white or grey.

rules.name: The Art Is the Colour Rule
rules.body: Card art is the only full-colour content. Gold, ornament and colour inside the art are Riot's, not the board's; the board's own gold is limited to the Pair tag.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number is set with tabular figures (set on body), so columns of counts and ratios line up and do not jitter when they change.

rules.name: The Normal Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels, no tracked-out caps, no condensed widths. Labels are sentence case at 12-13px.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: A panel is a lighter grey on black, never a bordered box. Borders are hairlines between rows, not frames around panels.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No coloured shadow, glow or neon outline anywhere. Focus is a 2px white (85%) outline at 2px offset; field focus is an inset 1px line-3 ring.

dos: Do keep the ground true black and build panels from the tonal steps card (#161618), raise and seg.
Do use green as the only accent, at full strength for text and fills that mean on, legal, complete or above par, and at 16% (green-soft) behind pills.
Do show value as a two-decimal tabular readout plus a bar growing from the centre par line at 1.00, green right, red left, softer inside 0.86-1.17.
Do set every number in tabular figures and every label in normal case system type.
Do use 6px corners on controls, 10px on grouped panels, and capsules for pills, chips and tags.
Do keep motion short and native: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) at 150-320ms, and honour reduced motion (transitions drop to 1ms, scripted fades and slides are skipped).
donts: Don't use red for anything but below-par values, limit breaches and errors.
Don't add a glow, coloured shadow or neon outline to tiles, panels or buttons.
Don't enlarge card art on hover; a 2-3px lift is the whole hover.
Don't set uppercase, tracked or condensed labels, and don't render numbers as split-flap cells.
Don't frame panels with borders or bevels; depth is a tonal step.
Don't use gold outside the Pair tag, or domain colours as fills behind text.
